Study Limitations

  1. Previously explored historical evaluation period.
  2. No statistically established positive alpha.
  3. Possible correlated and regime-sensitive signals.
  4. Adjusted-price / corporate-action accounting requires separate validation.
  5. Suspensions, stale marks and blocked order attempts.
  6. No full exchange price-limit, lot-size or market-impact simulation.
  7. Limited factor-risk and industry exposure controls.
  8. Stress-test transaction costs are approximate.
